summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Jill Novick, an American actress born January 20, 1966 in Westchester County, New York. It notes her role as Tracy Gaylian, Brandon's girlfriend, in the 1996–1997 season of Beverly Hills, 90210, and her role as the young Theodora "Teddy" Reed on the TV series Sisters.
one_line: American actress born 1966 in Westchester County, known for roles in Beverly Hills, 90210 and Sisters.
